messages:
june: Hey folks — PR #8421 touches runtime/CODEOWNERS and docs/guide. We have a release cut tomorrow morning and I'm blocked because CODEOWNERS is currently rotated. Files changed:
```
runtime/service/nginx.conf
runtime/service/handlers.py
docs/quickstart.md
```
Who can approve the runtime portion? I can split docs out if that speeds the merge. Pinged owners but no reply yet.

akshay: Are the runtime changes a behavior change or just config? If it's only nginx + tiny handler tweak maybe we can fast-path it.

sam: I'm out today but back first thing tomorrow morning EST. If it's low-risk config, I can do a quick pass after I get in and approve. How time-sensitive is the merge?

maria: Docs-only can definitely be fast-tracked by the docs team. Runtime changes need an eng-runtime/codeowner approval per policy. If owners are rotated, follow the CODEOWNERS-exception flow and tag eng-platform as a fallback.

-devops-bot: To request a CODEOWNERS exception, open an issue in infra-policy with the label `codeowners-exception` and mention @eng-platform. Exceptions have a 48h SLA; for urgent cases mark `priority:high` and include CCs.

june: Thanks — I don't want to wait 48h for docs. Plan: split into two PRs (docs-only + runtime). I'll split now and mark the runtime PR as WIP and ping approvers. If we still need to merge runtime before the cut, can we temporarily assign @akshay?

akshay: I can take the runtime piece. If it's just the nginx change + a small handler tweak, I'll run the smoke tests and approve. Please tag me in the split PR and include a short checklist: smoke tests passed, no model-path changes, rollout plan.

sam: Also add a short entry in the release notes under infra so SRE knows about the nginx tweak.

june: Will do. Splitting now, ETA ~1h. I'll post both PR links once ready and add the smoke test outputs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
